neal: Quick sync: we9re enabling `zephyr-mini` as a quiet canary tomorrow 06:00 UTC. Objective: validate model latency tails and fallback ordering without customer-visible routing changes.

iris: Plan: internal canary only (no external traffic) for 20m -> telemetry review -> gradual internal exposure to 10% dev traffic for 40m. If green, escalate to public canary later.

opsbot: opsbot note: priming recommended. Run during internal canary:
```sh
curl -s -X POST https://internal-cache/prime -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" -d '{"model":"zephyr-mini","prompts":15}'
```
This will reduce KV cold misses. Also temporarily set cache TTL=25s for 1h.

deploybot: deploybot preflight OK. Suggested emergency-pin thresholds: p95 >= +20% vs baseline over 10m OR error-rate >= 0.9% sustained 5m. Autopin will create PENDING event; operator must ACK to apply.

sam: I will own rapid pin/rollback. Runbook: 1) `platformctl pin --model=zephyr-stable --scope=global` 2) revoke canary weights 3) post update to #customer-uptime. If autopin PENDING appears, I'll ACK within 90s or execute immediate pin if severity > threshold.

claire: Fallback ordering for this run: 1) zephyr-alt-quant, 2) legacy-slim, 3) emergency-degen. Keep strict ordering so metrics map cleanly.

neal: Good. One more: make sure deploy logs tag `fallback_rank` and `canary_scope=internal` so SRE can filter. QA will run perf harness at 05:30 UTC and paste a short pass/fail here.

iris: QA scheduled and will paste results. Approved to proceed unless objections in next 2 hours. :thumbsup:
